senses.gloss: f. (ἱπποθόρος, sub. νόμος, שירת) a tune played to mares on being covered.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> (being asked why they rushed into the water, the horses said) <he>א׳ נעשית לכם בים</he> (ed. <cite ref="A01572"><he>איפתיסיס</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01572"><he>איפתוסים</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01567"><he>אפ׳</he></cite> corr. acc.) a hippothoros is prepared for you in the Sea (a satire on Egyptian lasciviousness).
